gate_applicability: Applicable as a reviewer-synthesis gate only. All fourteen claims remain proposed; no claim is promoted. C9, C10, and C13 are explicitly non-promoted. The human gate is separate and binding. The round-2 lethal observation is a future falsification criterion, not evidence; an executed empirical test outranks same-family reviewer consensus.

meta_findings.finding: The frozen document supports a constrained provenance reconciliation and a ledger of open tests; it does not support empirical confirmation, physical selection, or independent validation. Round-1 agreement is reading consistency within one model family, not evidence that changes any claim status.
meta_findings.source_location: Scope, what-is-not-tested, and review-status sections; both round-2 syntheses
meta_findings.test: Run the named future analyses from pinned inputs and compare their predeclared outputs; do not treat the review archive itself as validation.
meta_findings.reasoning: The document repeatedly bounds itself to inventory, status, provenance, and proposals. The same-model caveat is explicit, so consensus cannot promote a claim.

meta_findings.finding: The deepest unresolved issue is the missing typed bridge from the package-level Gamma, exponent, relativistic, and regime descriptions to common observables. Without one parent map, fixed units and invariant parameters, and matched holdouts, the strongest physical readings remain bookkeeping or hypotheses rather than selected model results.
meta_findings.source_location: Round-2 sharpest attack and C13 attack; frozen manuscript bridge and regime passages
meta_findings.test: Freeze one parent action and typed maps, pre-data regime boundaries, invariant coupling histories, shared nuisance models, and a blind joint holdout spanning the relevant sectors.
meta_findings.reasoning: This is a cross-claim closure problem, not evidence that any one proposed status is already false. It explains why C3, C5, C9, C10, and C13 remain proposed.

meta_findings.finding: The attacker's single 'lethal observation' is retained only as a future falsification-test criterion: a blind, preregistered joint holdout rejecting one fully typed EFC parent while an alternative passes and post-hoc regime boundaries are required. No such observation was supplied or observed in this review.
meta_findings.test: Execute the blind joint holdout only after the parent model, units, invariant siren history, a0/SPARC pipeline, regime classifier, alternatives, and decision rule are frozen.
meta_findings.reasoning: The attacker labels this as a prospective falsification observation. Treating it as present evidence would violate the frozen review scope and promote an unexecuted test.

meta_findings.finding: Two permanent caveats constrain this synthesis: the second pass used the same model family, and round 1 was partly steered toward the a0 freeze, C13 falsifiability, and siren background. These conditions weaken any consensus interpretation; an executed empirical test outranks the review consensus.
meta_findings.source_location: Run-manifest caveats and frozen role envelopes
meta_findings.reasoning: The caveats are methodological limits on reviewer independence and blind coverage, not physical evidence for or against EFC.
